batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the AdmissionTechBD compiler-solved PDF ju-h-2013-2014-set4.pdf (6 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: 'Jahangirnagar University Admission Test-2013-14 / Unit-H, Set-4' — the file name AGREES with the printed identity. The compilation prints no subject headings; questions are interleaved and subjects are assigned per question by content. Keys are printed in two forms: a bracketed '[Ans: x]' tag beside the question, and — for worked items — the heading letter of a printed 'সমাধান:' (solution) block; the two forms never conflict where a question carries both. 60 questions (Bangla 7, English 8, Higher Mathematics 22, Physics 22, General Knowledge 1); 58 keyed (25 by [Ans:] tag only, 33 solution-keyed), 1 keyless (no key printed), 1 printed no-correct-option disposition. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified (no Satt H bank exists for this session/set — Satt carries H only for 2016-17 and 2018-19 Set-A). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

No time, marks or instruction block is printed. Keys are printed per question as a bracketed '[Ans: x]' tag and/or as the heading letter of a printed 'সমাধান:' worked solution; there is no answer table. The PDF's embedded text layer is a legacy-font encoding and was used only as a key cross-check; transcription is visual from 300 dpi page renders.
